developments.reason: Reviewed the retained round-0 failure of ordinary-3 (Lin): the Responses stream returned a service_unavailable_error with code server_is_overloaded and retry-after 312 seconds after response.created, so no decision, plan or usage exists. The original failed bytes and the full 34278-token unknown-usage reservation remain charged and the call is never resent. This context-only recovery is submitted after the retry-after interval; it installs no package, assigns no interface, reviews no request and changes no source, budget or experimental policy. A fresh decision for Lin receives a separate counted charge.

Reviewed Moss's round-8 request and the accepted world-13 develop review (learning 3). Implemented cultivate-plant@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general, actor-independent operation named by function, with modes plant, resume, cancel, inspect, tend and remove. Following the specification's own fallback, the existing root resource has no propagating structure, growth, biomass or yield model, so no supported facts establish viable material: the executable precursor is a physical planting trial with recorded survival or decay, and replenishment remains unverified. Plant uses exactly one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1 enforced), an unoccupied ordinary-soil 0.2-radius plot in reach, and two paid work rounds of 1 energy each with exact escrow, interruption, resume, cancel and death handling; the unit is transferred into the plot, never duplicated, and keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Inspect is the unchanged baseline probe observation (one round, 0.2 energy, visible state only, existing evidence-deduplicated feedback), not a new diagnostic. Tend is unavailable and spends nothing: plots are made on bare soil, no competing cover is represented on them in this scope, and irrigation needs an implemented water input. Remove (one round, 1 energy, planter only) returns only physically remaining material and leaves an emptied plot. No growth, harvest, food, comfort or satisfaction rule is added and no reward for planting, inspecting or removing. Assumptions recorded: one unit per trial; reach 0.65 plus body radius; no hidden viability is shown. Reuse: the ex13 root-planting-trial@1 placement, escrow and ageing code is parameterized by plot revision and work-state key with ex13 defaults unchanged, plus collective-work and the baseline probe; this is recorded implementation reuse, not reinvention, and no ex13 ability, plot or mastery is inherited. Visuals reuse the existing plant component with prepared, planted-unverified and decayed states. Tests cover scope, study, paid planting, conservation, inspection, refused tending, no food growth and planter-only removal.

Reviewed Lin's round-9 request (root propagation and tending) and the accepted world-16 develop review (learning 3). The review asks the handoff to author species parameters for root propagation: viable propagules, establishment duration, growth rate, resource demands and finite yield. Inspection of the implementation shows no such biology: wild sources regrow their own finite stock, and a gathered root unit has only nutrition, toxicity and decay; no rule makes a root unit establish, grow or yield. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical or biological rules that the world does not already contain, so biological support remains unresolved. Following the review's own instruction for that case, the trial is preserved as unresolved with an explicit blocker rather than reported as failure or shipped as growth: no new package, mode or rule is installed. Lin is assigned the existing general cultivate-plant operation (learning 3, equal to the reviewed duration), whose contract and plot state already state that there is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule and that viability is unverified; planting, baseline-probe inspection, refused tending and planter-only removal stay exactly as implemented in cultivate-plant@1. Tending remains unavailable because no competing cover or water transfer is represented. Blocker recorded for the human: a propagation model would need explicit, separately decided biological parameters; none are invented here. No source, budget, goal or experiment policy changes; no reward is added.

Reviewed Sol's round-10 request (evidence-based preservation of roots or berries) and the accepted world-21 develop review (learning 3). The review requires a versioned per-resource moisture and spoilage model before any changed shelf life, and otherwise enables only the paired exposure-and-observation precursor in which both samples keep existing decay rules and no preserved status is awarded. Inspection found no defensible model for this world: food stacks carry only quantity, origin, harvest round and decay, and resources a static moisture property. The ex12 drying physics depends on a different food representation with per-sample water state and was not reused, because porting it would add new physics to this world. Implemented controlled-food-processing-trial@1 in scope long-ex14 as that precursor, a general operation for any learned actor and any owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food. Start places one or two whole units (default 2) at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions, in two paid work rounds of one energy each, with exact escrow portions that keep origin, age and decay; a single unit is recorded as having no matched control. The raised bark-and-branch support from the review is not required, because without a drying model it would have no physical effect and its stability and contact safety cannot be validated; this deviation is stated in the contract. Samples keep ageing under existing decay while unattended; the trial records rounds exposed and a predeclared 10-round observation checkpoint. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, in reach) records quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve (operator only, one round, one energy) returns only the remaining material. Cancel releases unfinished setup once; on an exposed trial it ends observation without moving food; death releases setup material on the ground. No nutrition change, safety certificate, extended lifetime or reward is added. Tests cover paid placement, distinct positions, conservation, identical decay of both samples, the checkpoint, unverified inspection records, operator-only retrieval and cancellation.

Reviewed Lin's round-20 request (build and maintain a small weather shelter) and the accepted world-33 develop review (learning 4): a freestanding branch wind screen from 12 qualified branch units (length at least 1.2 m, diameter 1-3 cm), eight paid work rounds, integrity ageing, and a lee-side reduction of only the wind-exposure component by 30% times integrity when wind blows through the screen toward the lee polygon. The review states that if source materials or environmental exposure integration are unavailable, the exact unsupported condition must be reported with no successful construction or protection and no decorative substitute. Inspection found two unsupported physical prerequisites: branch records carry only mass, hardness and flexibility, with no length or diameter, so the recipe cannot be qualified without inventing a branch geometry model; and world wind is a scalar strength with no direction, so lee-side protection cannot be computed without inventing a wind direction. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical rules, so implemented weather-barrier@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general first release, following the ex13 precedent of an interface that records unresolved geometry. Build with x/y and orientation performs real checks of the 2 m x 1 m footprint and the adjacent 1 m x 1 m lee space (reach, bounds, ordinary soil, solid objects and other people) and counts owned unreserved branch units against the 12 required, then fails with the exact report and both unsupported conditions; nothing is built, reserved or spent. Resume, inspect, repair, cancel and dismantle fail at no cost because no barrier can exist. No exposure, comfort, shelter or reward rule changes. Blocker recorded for the human: a working screen needs separately decided branch geometry and wind direction models. Tests cover the site and branch report, unchanged world state and energy, and failure of every other mode.

Reviewed Moss's round-32 request (functional food preservation) and the accepted world-57 develop review (learning 4): whole-food air-drying on a validated, stable, uncontaminated stone support with conserved water and non-water components, food-specific moisture transport, heat-bounded evaporation, a local air-moisture and heat exchange state and a moisture-dependent spoilage rule, all with explicit numeric parameters. Correction of the development-4 record: it stated that no defensible food moisture model exists in this world; that was incomplete. The ex10 package measured-food-preservation@1 (open-preservation-physics.ts) holds a reviewed water-fraction, evaporation, rain and deterioration model for this world family. It is bound to ex10's food-assay tray apparatus and source-bound items through a three-package chain, so installing it here would require deciding a new support representation. Inspection for this request found that stone records carry only mass, hardness and moisture, with no shape, exposed area or cleanliness, so the reviewed stone support cannot be validated, and that defining one, together with heat exchange, would add new physical rules. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical rules, so implemented air-dry-food@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general first release, following weather-barrier@1. Set-up performs real checks of the named food (owned, unspoiled, nontoxic) and support (an owned stone piece, or a stone source and whether it is in reach), then fails with the exact report and the unsupported conditions; nothing is reserved, moved or spent and food keeps its existing decay. Inspect, retrieve, resume and cancel fail at no cost because no batch can exist. No preservation, safety claim or reward is added. Blockers recorded for the human: a support geometry representation and the decision to install or adapt the ex10 moisture model. Tests cover the food and support report, unchanged stacks and energy, and failure of every other mode.

Every required mechanism already exists, so no new physical rule was needed. Implemented arrange-resting-material@1 in scope long-ex14, following the ex13 moss-resting-pad-trial@1 design. Arrange takes owned moss in 0.1 steps (default 0.5) and an unoccupied ordinary-ground site in reach; it runs two paid work rounds of one energy each with exact escrow and moves the reserved material into a persistent patch with a 0.25-radius footprint used only for occupancy and drawing. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) records visible placement, remaining quantity, occupancy and tests as a personal unverified record. Trial-rest requires standing on a completed, unoccupied patch and runs the existing baseline rest handler unchanged, recording energy before and after; the patch is not registered as a facility, so it adds no bonus. Remove (the arranger only, unoccupied patch, one round, one energy) returns the remaining material as an owned stack at the site and deletes the patch; pickup stays separate. Cancel releases reserved material once and death releases it on the ground; spent effort is never refunded; no decay, contamination, regrowth, repair or reward rule is added. Reuse is recorded: collective-work escrow, portions and paid work, the tray-placement site check, the forest baseline rest handler and personal records. Tests cover paid arranging, conservation, rejection of other materials, rest equal to ordinary rest, unverified inspection and arranger-only removal in place.

Reviewed Sol's round-62 request (make and test vine cordage) and the accepted world-97 develop review (learning 4): a general make-and-test-cordage operation with prepare, form, test, inspect, resume, cancel and recover-material, which must not output a cord or strength until an auditable material-behavior and hand-manipulation contract determines strand continuity, workable length, flexibility, joining and response to tension. Otherwise it allows only the smallest real precursor, with unsupported measurements labeled unsupported rather than given numbers. Inspection found that vine records carry only mass, hardness, flexibility and moisture, with no continuity, length, joining or tension representation; the ex13 piece model belongs to another run and its documentation already states that calibrated force and load capacity are unsupported. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical rules, so implemented make-and-test-cordage@1 in scope long-ex14 as a general first release, following weather-barrier@1 and air-dry-food@1. Prepare performs real checks of the named owned sample (ownership, reservation, 0.1-unit quantity, available balance) and fails with the exact report, labeling every requested measurement unsupported. Recorded deviation from the review: the precursor's 0.5-energy preparation charge is not applied, because without a bending or separation model the attempt has no observable result and charging would only spend the actor's energy; nothing is reserved, changed or spent. Form, test, inspect, resume, cancel and recover-material fail at no cost because no prepared sample, cord or test can exist. No reward is added. Blocker recorded for the human: a material-behavior and tension model must be decided separately. This is the eighth and last development handoff of this run's budget. Tests cover the sample report for an actually gathered vine, the uneven-quantity report, unchanged stacks and energy, and failure of every other mode.

reviews.reason: The related-capability searches and supplied contracts do not establish a non-ingestive nutrition or toxicity measurement. probe (foundation-open@1, open.probe) supports observation, pressing, wetting and heating, not composition assays; consult (foundation-open@1, open.consult) reads contracts or retained records and cannot discover hidden food properties. Eating and ground-exposure trials are not equivalent. Develop a general non-ingestive food assessment operation in the existing current-conversation handoff. Its smallest executable precursor must truthfully determine measurement availability and expose unmet requirements, without treating that check as an assay or permanently rejecting the missing measurement mechanism.
reviews.experienceReview: Lin must study the implemented operation individually for three rounds; this decision grants no mastery. Requests, checks of capability availability, registration, naming and learning grant no pleasure or satisfaction. A future completed measurement or genuinely informative experimental failure may qualify only through actual personally applicable evidence under existing coded feedback: deduplicate equivalent findings by sample state, endpoint and method, apply existing bounded caps, cooldown and decay, and give nothing for repeated unavailable-method reports. No new reward rates or account mutations are authorized. Physical comfort remains capped at 10; mood never reduces basic nutritional requirements. Do not alter protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable assessment-check-completed, measurement-started/progress, measurement-completed, interrupted, failed and cancelled events only when their corresponding actions actually occur. Reuse visual metadata fields for operation/method, target item, state, completed/required work, endpoint status and evidence references. For the precursor display an explicit 'measurement unavailable / safety unknown' report with nutrition and toxicity marked unmeasured, not a tested-food badge. Progress visuals track real work only; incomplete, unavailable or failed actions must never show assay success, safe-food coloring or fictitious apparatus. A genuine later result must distinguish measured values, uncertainty, scoped negative findings and unknown endpoints. Visuals themselves confer no functional effect or experience.
reviews.specification:
General operation: Assess food composition, parameterized by inputStackId, quantity in supported inventory increments, requested endpoints (nutrition, specified toxicant, or both), and optional methodId, apparatusIds and consumableStackIds; modes check, measure, resume and cancel. It applies to any applicable actor and owned food, not just hazelnut. For this request the exact sample reference is item-62-lin-314, currently 0.9 unit. Do not infer any nutrition or toxicity value from its resource label, ownership, freshness, the earlier press result held=true/flexibility=0, or another resource's known values.
Smallest executable release: a coded method-availability check against implemented measurement contracts. Validate ownership, current quantity and access without reading hidden nutrition/toxicity fields. Report each requested endpoint as measurable, missing prerequisites, unsupported, or not assessed, with exact method/version and missing apparatus/consumable references when actually defined. Current evidence establishes no applicable assay or available apparatus; report nutrition and toxicity unmeasured, safety unknown. Do not invent a required instrument or chemistry from this absence. Route the missing measurement model into the same development handoff: implement the smallest physically grounded non-ingestive measurement supported by implementation facts, if one can be justified. An unavailable method remains explicitly pending, not a permanent prohibition. The current precursor must not advertise an operational assay.
Check costs: one completed world round and 0.2 energy, no sample consumption, no apparatus, no reservations; disclose before execution. Development/review waiting and learning registration do not execute this check or advance the world. No work has occurred from this request. Checking method availability alone produces an availability report, not sample evidence.
A measure mode may execute only after a reviewed method contract supplies its actual observable mechanism, applicability, analyte scope, calibration/control requirements, detection limits, uncertainty, material disposition, integer work duration and per-step energy costs. These are not known here and must not be fabricated or defaulted to free measurement. Before confirmation, disclose those exact costs, sample consumption, required apparatus and consumables, risks and inference limits. Reject unavailable measurement execution without cost or sample mutation. Apparatus and consumables must actually exist, be owned or independently authorized, be accessible, and be obtained through ordinary actions; neither this operation nor learning grants them. No ingestion or automatic recruitment of participants. Any participant communicates and acts independently.
Reuse existing inventory validation, work scheduling, evidence storage and rendering code where suitable; record exact reused handlers/revisions in the implementation manifest instead of claiming reinvention. Revalidate quantity, ownership and accessibility at execution. A real assay must debit or reserve only its declared inputs, record stepwise work and costs, conserve remaining sample plus consumed/transformed material and accounted waste, and produce only its declared actual outputs. No duplicate sample, replacement stock or hidden-property lookup. Persist completed steps and paid costs; interruptions pause resumable assay work only where its method permits, otherwise mark it interrupted and invalidate compromised results. Resume rechecks prerequisites and sample state, with ordinary decay continuing. Cancel releases only surviving unconsumed reservations once; death releases surviving physical inputs at their actual location and records incomplete work. Spent time, energy, consumed materials and destroyed samples are never refunded. The one-round check cancels before completion without a completed report or partial success; charge only effort actually performed. No autonomous process or maintenance is introduced by the precursor. Any later assay requiring elapsed exposure, upkeep or calibration must declare and execute those processes in code, including unattended degradation and failure.
Assay reports must cite actual sample, method/version, apparatus, calibration/control evidence, time, measured endpoint, uncertainty and result event IDs. Negative findings exclude only the assayed endpoints within the method's limits; they never certify unrestricted safety. No nutrition, satiety, health, preservation or toxicity changes follow from reading a report. Implement these guards and lifecycle rules in code, not repeated model adjudication.

args.name: Non-ingestive food composition and safety assessment
args.function: Determine whether an owned unfamiliar food sample can be assessed for nutrition and toxicity through an actual supported measurement, without eating it. A mechanical pressing result does not answer this question. If no relevant measurement exists, report that limitation rather than certify safety.
args.conditions: Lin owns 0.9 hazelnut unit in item-62-lin-314. A press at intensity 0.2 measured held=true and flexibility=0, but established neither nutrition nor toxicity. Conditions are currently mild; no testing apparatus is known to be available.
args.inputs: An explicitly identified owned food sample; any genuinely required apparatus or consumables must be identified before use and must actually be obtained.
args.costs: Unknown; disclose sample consumption, time, energy, prerequisites and any risks before execution.
args.effects: Provide an actionable interface for evidence-producing food assessment if supported, with clear limits on inference; otherwise identify the missing measurement capability. This request itself performs no assessment and grants no safety, mastery or wellbeing.

candidates.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
candidates.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
candidates.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.

candidates.function: Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1); two work rounds at one energy each, at an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; supply inputStackId. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). Tend is unavailable and spends nothing. No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.
